retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style record cover featuring a large-scale grotesque title over a rounded-corner photo inset on a solid mustard background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured graphic layout characterized by a dominant mustard-yellow field, a large-scale two-line sans-serif title at the top, and a central portrait contained within a large rounded-corner rectangle. The composition uses a secondary block-style logo in the upper right corner and a tracklist in small, right-aligned text.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale bold title anchored to the top-left margin
Rounded-corner photo frame centered horizontally in the lower two-thirds
Right-aligned metadata and logo blocks balancing the heavy left-aligned title
Color harmony between the warm background and the cool-toned subject clothing
coreInvariants: Rounded corners on the primary image container

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human subject is centered within a rounded rectangular frame, occupying approximately 60% of the total vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, bold red-orange title text in the top-left corner acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left title, across to the logo block on the right, then down into the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial solid-color margins surround the central image, creating a 'window' effect.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale blue and white within the photograph for cooling contrast
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with a slightly desaturated, naturalistic photo inset.

letterConstructionRules: Square-ish proportions in the display weight
characterSpecificRedesigns: Flattened tops on rounded characters in the display face
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and scales of the same Grotesque family to maintain mid-century consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the blocky, authoritative feel of the main title.
Provides the clean, neutral look for the subtitle and tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid mustard yellow field with a large centered portrait of a man in a blue sweater, contained within a rounded-corner rectangle that has a slight inner shadow to suggest a paper cutout.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large-scale bold sans-serif text in the top left in red-orange. Add a secondary line of text below it in dark olive. Place a small vertical column of right-aligned text and a square logo block in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent mustard yellow?
Is the main title text heavy and sans-serif?
Is the layout balanced between left-heavy text and right-heavy logo blocks?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the photo frame
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the rounded photo frame.
Check that the mustard yellow is warm and not neon.
Verify the display font is uppercase and tightly spaced.
Confirm the portrait is centered within its frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Mustard Field + Rounded Photo Inset + Heavy Grotesque Header = 1960s Record Aesthetic
